overview: The Conservation Commission continued notices of intent for Mystic River Road improvements, a parking lot expansion on Sycamore Avenue following extensive abutter concerns about flooding and wildlife, and a Route 28 boardwalk connection. Commissioners requested technical clarifications, stormwater details, and site visits before rendering decisions.

items.title: Notice of Intent: Mystic River Road Improvements (DEP File 215-0239)
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to January 22, 2025, at the request of the city engineering office to allow time to assemble requested documents.

items.title: Notice of Intent: 28 Sycamore Avenue Parking Lot Expansion (DEP File 215-0238)
items.summary: Continued the hearing to January 22, 2025, with an interim site visit planned, after extensive public testimony and commission questions regarding tree removal, stormwater management, high groundwater, and flooding within isolated land subject to flooding.

items.title: Notice of Intent: Route 28 Pathway and Boardwalk (DEP File 215-0240)
items.summary: Continued the hearing to January 8, 2025, with the applicant asked to provide a detailed planting plan, decking material alternatives to tropical hardwood, and stormwater calculations for the proposed multi-use connection.

items.title: Commission Business and Updates
items.summary: Received updates from staff on upcoming filings, discussed scheduling logistics for potential site visits, and noted pending meeting minutes.
